title: Synthetic WMS problem tickets for inquiry workflow

tickets.title: Scan retry may apply an operation twice
tickets.report: A scan request times out. After the worker retries, it is unclear whether the first request changed inventory, so the operation may be applied twice.

problem.condition: A scan times out without a clear outcome, and the operator cannot tell whether the first request changed inventory.
problem.impact: Retrying may apply the inventory change twice, while not retrying may leave the operation incomplete.

tickets.title: Similar screen definitions have unclear differences
tickets.report: Two screen definitions look similar. It is unknown whether one is obsolete or whether they represent different warehouse cases.

problem.condition: Two similar screen definitions have no known distinction or confirmed usage.
problem.affected: Replacement builder and users of the represented warehouse workflows
problem.impact: The team cannot safely decide what to retain or reproduce and may omit a distinct workflow.

tickets.title: Screen fails before it appears
tickets.report: Opening screen S-127 produces an error. Its intended purpose and expected content are unknown.

problem.condition: Opening screen S-127 fails before it appears, and its intended purpose is unknown.
problem.affected: Potential user of screen S-127 and the replacement builder
problem.impact: The screen cannot be made usable or validated until its purpose and expected behavior are discovered.

tickets.title: Screen fields render but their meaning is unclear
tickets.report: The replacement screen renders, but the meaning and requiredness of several fields are unknown.

problem.condition: Several rendered fields have unknown meanings and requiredness.
problem.affected: Replacement builder and users entering data on the screen
problem.impact: The team cannot reliably decide what data to request or validate, risking incorrect or incomplete handling.

tickets.title: Validation error has an unknown cause
tickets.report: Entering a value produces a validation error. It is unclear whether the value violates a warehouse rule or the screen is misconfigured.

problem.condition: Entering a value is rejected, but it is not known whether the rule or the screen setup is responsible.
problem.impact: The operator cannot proceed, and the replacement behavior cannot be corrected safely without learning the applicable rule.

tickets.title: Screen has no agreed success condition
tickets.report: The screen can be made to render, but the outcome that would make it correct is unknown.

problem.condition: The screen renders but has no agreed outcome that defines successful behavior.
problem.affected: Replacement builder and intended screen users
problem.impact: The team cannot determine when the screen is correct or accept the implementation.

tickets.title: Screen has no known place in the workflow
tickets.report: A screen definition exists, but what leads to it, what it depends on, and what should happen afterward are unknown.

problem.condition: The screen's entry point, dependencies, and next workflow step are unknown.
problem.affected: Replacement builder and users of the workflow
problem.impact: The team may omit the screen or connect it incorrectly, leaving the intended workflow incomplete.

tickets.title: Interrupted replenishment is difficult to resume
tickets.report: After a device change or shift handoff, the next worker cannot tell whether replenishment was started, partly completed, or not recorded.

problem.condition: After a device change or shift handoff, the next worker cannot determine the replenishment task's recorded progress.
problem.affected: The worker handing off and the next-shift replenisher
problem.impact: They cannot safely resume; work may be duplicated or left incomplete.
